correctness.rationale: Uniform regeneration yields unique symmetric invariant measure. Reversible Green-function and sequential first-hit identities give exact pi(1)/pi(0) and pi(2)/pi(1). Recurrence for -1/2<epsilon<0 follows from divergent resistance, forcing each discounted hitting transform to run continuously and strictly from 0 to 1; therefore both roots uniquely exist. The site-one balance equation at the first root forces pi(2)/pi(1)=2(2-s)/(s(2+epsilon))>1, proving r1<r2. Summability forces finite outer maxima, and continuity proves an interval where outer mass exceeds central mass. A standalone 162-check numerical diagnostic independently propagates the kernel; the infinite statement is proved analytically.
